name: 3D Distance-Aware SSIM
definition: A structural similarity loss computed in 3D space using a 3D distance-aware Gaussian kernel to mitigate invalid structural similarity penalties between adjacent pixels in 2D image space that originate from different viewpoints.
summary: 3D Distance-Aware SSIM is a regularization loss that computes structural similarity in 3D world space to prevent invalid penalties between adjacent pixels originating from different viewpoints.
